clue.text: Pub's first of eight in immediate area

parts.note: the local is a British name for one's neighbourhood pub

indicators.note: first of asks for only the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: its opening letter is E

explanation.surface: A drinker counts eight pubs within walking distance of home.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after Pub reads as 'has', joining the pub to the letter that follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A locale is a place or neighbourhood, the surroundings where something happens.

clue.text: Launch unfinished biography with support of aristocrat

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits underneath, holding the first up
unfinished says the word for biography loses its final letter

parts.note: a life is a biography
a toff is British slang for a posh or upper-class person

explanation.surface: A half-written life story gets published thanks to a noble backer.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue the aristocrat sits beneath the shortened life story, so it supports it; a toff is British slang for a posh person.
explanation.definitionFit: Lift-off is the moment a rocket leaves the ground, its launch.

clue.text: Telegram: TAXI LEFT HALFWAY THROUGH

parts.note: a cab is a taxi

indicators.note: halfway means only the first half of the next word is kept

parts.note: its first half is the first two of its four letters

explanation.surface: Written in capitals like a telegram: a cab drove off midway along its route.
explanation.walkthrough: The capitals mimic the style of an old telegram message.
explanation.definitionFit: A cable is an old word for a telegram, sent by wire.

clue.text: Not intervening — a variety of sizes satisfactory in Dior article

indicators.note: the clue word that signals this step

parts.note: Dior is French, and le is the French masculine 'the'

indicators.note: a variety of the letters means they are rearranged

parts.note: rearranged to ISSEZ
fair means satisfactory, reasonably good

explanation.surface: A fashion item from Dior comes in a range of acceptable sizes.
explanation.walkthrough: Dior points to French, so the article wanted is the French 'le', not English 'the'; 'in' sets the rest inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Laissez-faire is the policy of leaving things alone, letting events take their course without interference.

clue.text: Bakery centrally getting behind beginning to create a bakery product

indicators.note: getting behind puts the central letters after the first two pieces
beginning to asks for the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: its opening letter is C

indicators.note: centrally keeps just the two middle letters of the six-letter word

parts.note: its middle two letters are KE

explanation.surface: A baker starts making something in the middle of the shop.
explanation.walkthrough: Bakery has six letters, so its centre is the pair K and E.
explanation.definitionFit: Cake is a sweet baked food sold by a baker's shop.

clue.text: Sailor, solitary, will find shellfish

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a common abbreviation for a sailor
alone means solitary

explanation.surface: A lone seaman will come across shellfish on the shore.
explanation.definitionFit: Abalone is an edible sea mollusc with an ear-shaped shell lined with mother-of-pearl.

clue.text: Employ skilled person to remove phosphorus

indicators.note: to remove says the element's letter is taken out of the skilled person

parts.note: an expert is a skilled person
P is the chemical symbol for phosphorus

explanation.surface: A firm hires a specialist to strip phosphorus out of something.
explanation.definitionFit: To exert strength or influence is to bring it into use, to apply it.

clue.text: Embargo involving English vegetable

indicators.note: involving means the first word holds the second within it

parts.note: a ban is an embargo

explanation.surface: A trade embargo covering an English vegetable crop.
explanation.definitionFit: A bean is a leguminous plant whose seeds or pods are eaten.

clue.text: Later addition making contribution to rafter, though temporary

indicators.note: making contribution to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A builder adds a temporary beam to the roof as an extra.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put 'making' in the definition, but 'Later addition making' cannot stand for a noun; 'making contribution to' is the whole signal for the hidden run.
explanation.definitionFit: An afterthought is something added later, not part of the original plan.

clue.text: Anger after second month with a fever

indicators.note: after puts the word for anger following the month

parts.note: Feb is the abbreviation for February, the second month
to rile is to anger

explanation.surface: Someone fumes in February while running a temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: Febrile means feverish, from the Latin for fever, and so describes someone feverish.

clue.text: Reputation overwhelming Liberal lover

indicators.note: overwhelming means the first word engulfs the second

parts.note: fame is a reputation
L is the abbreviation for Liberal in politics

explanation.surface: A political lover whose standing overpowers the party.
explanation.definitionFit: An old flame is a former sweetheart, so flame means a lover.

clue.text: Royal honour is article given to church in reverence

parts.note: OBE, Order of the British Empire, is an honour from the monarch
an is the indefinite article
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A newly honoured person goes to church to show their respect.
explanation.definitionFit: Obeisance is a gesture of deep respect, such as a bow, showing reverence.

clue.text: Dismissed in contest, but not bowled

indicators.note: but not says the cricket letter is left out of the contest

parts.note: a bout is a contest, as in boxing
B is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for bowled

explanation.surface: A cricketer was dismissed in a match, though not by being bowled.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a cricket dismissal; the def is the batsman being out.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a batsman who is out has been dismissed.

clue.text: Wall decoration to stop moving, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: to freeze is to stop moving suddenly

explanation.surface: A decorator is told to keep still beside the wall.
explanation.definitionFit: A frieze is a decorated horizontal band along the top of a wall.

clue.text: I'd year the reverse of cold and ill — delightful

indicators.note: the reverse of says the letters for cold and ill are read backwards

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a year of being cold and sick, the opposite of delightful.
explanation.definitionFit: Idyllic describes something perfectly peaceful and charming, like a pastoral idyll.

clue.text: Elm, say, planted in stone in part of city

indicators.note: planted in puts the plant inside the stone abbreviation

parts.note: st is the abbreviation for stone, a British weight of 14 pounds
an elm is an example of a tree

explanation.surface: An elm tree is planted in stone somewhere in town.
explanation.definitionFit: A street is a public road lined with buildings, a section of a town.

clue.text: Juvenile horse last in race after support on course

indicators.note: after puts the horse and final letter following the support

parts.note: a tee supports the ball on a golf course
a nag is a horse, often an old one

indicators.note: last in asks for the final letter of the next word

parts.note: its final letter is E

explanation.surface: A young horse finishes last in a race on a racecourse.
explanation.walkthrough: The course is a golf course, not a racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: Teenage describes someone in their teens, a young person not yet adult.

clue.text: Cunning insect

definitions.meaning: first meaning: British informal for shrewd or knowing

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both British slang for sharp or crafty and the name of a common two-winged insect.

clue.text: Father carrying flightless bird's bone

indicators.note: carrying means the first word holds the bird inside it

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title
the emu is a large Australian bird that cannot fly

explanation.surface: A priest carries a flightless bird's bone.
explanation.definitionFit: The femur is the thigh bone, the longest in the human body.

clue.text: An irksome job importing silver in Alaskan city

indicators.note: importing means the job takes in the metal symbol

parts.note: a chore is a tedious task
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A tiresome task of bringing in silver in an Alaskan city.
explanation.definitionFit: Anchorage is the largest city in Alaska.

clue.text: What cow chews is about right for dairy product

indicators.note: about means the cow's food wraps round the letter for right

parts.note: cud is the food a cow chews again

explanation.surface: A cow chewing its cud is close to making milk products.
explanation.definitionFit: Curd is the solid part of soured milk, used to make cheese.

clue.text: Notice Liberal making off-the-cuff remark

parts.note: an ad is a notice, an advertisement

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician spots something and speaks unscripted.
explanation.definitionFit: An ad lib is an improvised line spoken without preparation.

clue.text: Damage seen around most of ancient tooth

indicators.note: around means the damage word encircles the trimmed ancient

parts.note: to mar is to damage

indicators.note: most of says the word for ancient loses its final letter

parts.note: old means ancient

explanation.surface: Decay has been found around an old tooth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Most of' trims the synonym for ancient by its last letter before it goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A molar is a back grinding tooth.

clue.text: What should monarch have? Excellent beer, on reflection

indicators.note: on reflection means the letters are seen as in a mirror, back to front

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written here as AI
lager is a type of beer

explanation.surface: Wondering what a king needs, someone muses that it is a fine beer.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 is written AI, the 1 standing as an I; AI + LAGER backwards gives REGALIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Regalia are the crown, sceptre and other emblems of royalty a sovereign owns.

clue.text: Popular music sees female abandoning dress

indicators.note: abandoning means the letter for female leaves the dress

parts.note: a frock is a dress

explanation.surface: A pop star gives up wearing a dress.
explanation.definitionFit: Rock is a genre of popular music with a strong beat.

clue.text: Farm building, not fresh, with black interior

indicators.note: interior says the stale word has the letter for black inside it

parts.note: stale means not fresh
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A musty farm building, dark inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A stable is a farm building where horses are kept.
